title: Provisional Payments Added Back to the Reportable Balance (Placed Consumer Accounts)
content:
Credit Reporting team note for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the provisional payments added back in working out the reporting-floor pay-down, after returns that suggest recent payments may still come back.

## Note

The reportable balance is the balance due for the pay-down plus the provisional payments added back, and the reporting floor is subtracted from the reportable balance. The provisional payments added back are:
- **every bank-debit and card payment received in the last two months** (ACH bank debit, debit card and credit card), where one or more payments returned for "unauthorized debit" or "stop payment" were received on the account in the last six months;
- **the bank-debit payments received in the last two months**, where no such return but one or more payments returned for NSF or "account closed" were received in the last six months;
- **nothing**, where no payment returned for any of those four reasons was received in the last six months; the reportable balance is then the balance due.

## Terms

- *Payments returned for a reason*: returned-payment entries on the account's money history, read by their recorded return reason and dated when the return was received. A card chargeback is not one of the four reasons.
- *Payments received in the last two months*: consumer payments posted on the account's money history in those channels, at their posted amounts, dated fewer than two whole calendar months before the handling date.
- *Returns in the last six months*: dated fewer than six whole calendar months before the handling date.
- A whole month is reached on the same day of a later month.

## Decision table

| Unauthorized-debit or stop-payment return in the last six months | NSF or account-closed return in the last six months | Added back |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | Bank-debit, debit-card and credit-card payments of the last two months |
| No | Yes | Bank-debit payments of the last two months |
| No | No | Nothing |

## Hypothetical worked case

*Invented money history, handling date 2026-10-10:* bank-debit payment $400.00 on 2026-09-01, debit-card payment $150.00 on 2026-08-20, credit-card payment $100.00 on 2026-08-05 (more than two whole months back), balance due for the pay-down $700.00.

| Returns in the last six months | Added back | Reportable balance |
|---|---|---|
| A stop-payment return on 2026-06-12 | $400.00 plus $150.00, that is $550.00 | $1250.00 |
| An NSF return on 2026-06-12 only | $400.00 | $1100.00 |
| A card chargeback on 2026-06-12 only | Nothing | $700.00 |
